verdict.rationale: The docs show that Paxos versions its APIs: the brokerage guide refers to "Paxos API v2.0", and the Sandbox replicates "core v2 API functionality". Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timeline, changelog or version-migration guidance, so only the versioning half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation/sunset timelines and notices, changelog or migration guides between versions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Get market data, create orders, execute held-rate quotes, and transfer assets with Paxos API v2.0.
The Developer Sandbox replicates core v2 API functionality
